# Client Brief: GreenScape Landscaping

## Business

GreenScape Landscaping — residential and commercial landscaping in Phoenix, AZ. 15 years in business, 12 employees, family-owned.

## Website Goal

Replace the current single-page WordPress site with a multi-page site that ranks for local search terms and converts visitors into quote requests...

sections.body:
Phoenix's Trusted Landscaping Partner for 15 Years
